verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a general bulk-operations capability, such as bulk editing, closing or updating many repos, PRs or issues in one action, or a batch API. The nearby items do not count. Organization-wide policy enforcement, merge checks and multi-repo deploy keys are scoping and permission controls. The migration app is a one-off Server-to-Cloud move. These are adjacent features, not bulk operations. Community users also report having to move 50+ repos manually.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
